title: The Frequency Shift — EN/ES/FR (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 102bpm modulating synth pads ethereal harmonics minimal beat English Spanish French language learning trilingual cosmic
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
There's a moment in every transmission
When the frequency shifts
Not by much
By exactly enough

[Verse 2 — Español]
El oyente no nota el cambio de frecuencia [The listener doesn't notice the frequency shift]
Nota la sensación después del cambio [They notice the feeling after the shift]
Esa sensación de llegada [That feeling of arrival]
Esa sensación de — ah, ahí está [That feeling of — oh, there it is]
Eso es el cambio de frecuencia [That's the frequency shift]

[Chorus — English]
Frequency shift
Everything adjusts
Frequency shift
Nothing is lost
DEPHYRIER in the frequency shift
Every day

[Bridge — Français]
L'opérateur radio connaît ce sentiment [The radio operator knows this feeling]
Le musicien connaît ce sentiment [The musician knows this feeling]
Le poète connaît ce sentiment [The poet knows this feeling]
La personne debout à une fenêtre à 4h du matin connaît ce sentiment [The person standing at a window at 4am knows this feeling]
DEPHYRIER est la fréquence qui l'a causé [DEPHYRIER is the frequency that caused it]

[Verse 3 — English]
Most people think clarity is the absence of noise
DEPHYRIER knows clarity is a different noise

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Frequency shift
Cambio de frecuencia [Frequency shift]
Changement de fréquence [Frequency shift]
DEPHYRIER
